description: This PHP source file defines the RequestHandler class within the Drupal REST module. It acts as an intermediate request forwarder for resource plugins, handling REST API requests, deserialization, delegation to resource plugins, and response preparation.

classes.name: RequestHandler
classes.description: Handles REST API requests within Drupal, acting as a request forwarder, deserializer, and response preparer for resource plugins.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the serializer dependency.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate RequestHandler with the serializer service from the container.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Processes a REST API request, deserializes input, delegates to resource plugin, and prepares response.

methods.name: handleRaw
methods.description: Processes a REST API request without deserializing the request body.

methods.name: prepareResponse
methods.description: Adds cache dependencies to the response if applicable and returns it.

methods.name: getNormalizedRequestMethod
methods.description: Retrieves the HTTP method for the route, respecting route-defined methods.

methods.name: deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes the request body into an object, handling errors for malformed data.

methods.name: delegateToRestResourcePlugin
methods.description: Delegates the request to the appropriate resource plugin method based on HTTP method.

methods.name: createArgumentResolver
methods.description: Creates an ArgumentsResolver instance with route parameters, unserialized data, and request info.
